findings.title: Fallback locales are only preloaded for controller requests
findings.body: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only called from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. The patched `I18n.translate` lazily loads only `config.locale` (`lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:68`), so server-side code outside the controller, such as Sidekiq jobs, mailers, and rake tasks, does not load the fallback locale's YAML. When a translation is missing in the current locale, the Fallbacks backend tries `:en`, but `en.yml` may not be loaded, so the lookup raises a missing translation instead of returning the English fallback. Fallback locales should be ensured in the translation path or in a global locale change hook, not just in this before_filter.

findings.title: No tests cover the new fallback order or lazy loading
findings.body: The PR adds custom fallback behavior (`FallbackLocaleList`) and a controller `ensure_loaded!` call, but includes no tests. At minimum, specs should assert the fallback order, that fallback locale files get loaded, and that translations in non-controller contexts such as jobs or mailers fall back correctly; otherwise the lazy-loading bug can regress.
